address.resolved: 2001 Palm Beach Lakes Blvd. Suite 300G, West Palm Beach, FL 33409
address.how_resolved: DISCREPANCY FOUND AND RESOLVED. Two candidate addresses appeared in discovery: (A) 3233 Commerce Pl Suite A113, West Palm Beach, FL 33407 -- appears on Groupon (live page fetched, title and body both say this), Birdeye/Google-reviews aggregator, and bizprofile.net/Yelp aggregator (3 independent secondary sources). (B) 2001 Palm Beach Lakes Blvd. Suite 300G, West Palm Beach, FL 33409 -- appears ONLY on the business's own live GlossGenius booking site (divineelegancestudio.glossgenius.com), both in the embedded JSON-LD business_address field and in the rendered /about page, which explicitly labels its nav tab '- Current location' next to this exact address. Verification steps: (1) fetched GlossGenius /services page source and extracted the embedded __NEXT_DATA__.props.serverContext.publicUser.business_address field directly from the platform's own backend record (not a scrape/guess): '2001 Palm Beach Lakes Blvd. Suite 300G, West Palm Beach, FL 33409', with matching business_address_latitude/longitude. (2) Reverse-geocoded those exact coordinates via OpenStreetMap Nominatim -> resolved to house_number 2001, Palm Beach Lakes Boulevard, West Palm Beach, FL 33409, confirming internal consistency (the GlossGenius pin was generated from that same address, not a stray/default pin). (3) Fetched GlossGenius /about page separately: it renders the identical address under a 'Business Hours' block, and the page's own breadcrumb tags that section '- Current location'. (4) Checked Sunbiz search results (via web search only, direct fetch blocked 403): found a THIRD address, 1025 7th St, West Palm Beach FL 33401, which is the LLC's registered-agent/principal filing address (a legal/mailing address, not necessarily the treatment studio) -- not used for the site since it does not represent the physical service location and is not corroborated by any consumer-facing source. Decision: used (B), the business's own live, operationally-critical, explicitly-labeled 'current location' record on its own booking platform, over the 3 secondary aggregator listings at 3233 Commerce Pl, which are treated as a likely stale/former address that Groupon/Yelp/Birdeye have not had corrected (common when a business relocates but does not update every third-party directory). No signal of business closure or rename was found; business appears active (Yelp page 'Updated July 2026', Groupon listing live, GlossGenius booking site live and current).

reviews_used_on_site.author: Rebeka S.
reviews_used_on_site.text: Desiree is amazing her shop is cozy and welcoming. I received a number of services from her and each time is a wonderful experience. Definitely a place I'd recommend

reviews_used_on_site.author: Ashley Morris
reviews_used_on_site.text: My experience always been very pleasant from day 1. Desiree is very warm welcoming. Her salon is very cozy and clean. She makes getting a wax very comfortable. She has a very great talent and technique. I also recently got a facial. One of the BEST facial services I ever had. Thank you so much!!

reviews_used_on_site.author: Dawn
reviews_used_on_site.text: Desiree as very personable and professional. She made me feel comfortable and put me at ease. She had pleasant conversation which also helped distract you from any waxing discomfort. Her shop was also clean and charming. I would definitely recommend and plan to return.
